title: China's Actions on US Sanctions and Drone Export Controls
description: China has imposed sanctions on the US and tightened export controls on drone-related items ahead of President Xi Jinping's visit.

sources.title: China hits US with sanctions, drone export curbs ahead of Xi visit
China to tighten export controls on drone-related dual-use items to US for ‘national security’
No need to show courtesy to the enforcers and accomplices of US sanctions against China: Global Times editorial

sections.heading: China's Sanctions on the US
paragraphs: China has announced sanctions on the US in response to American sanctions imposed on Chinese officials, according to CNN.

sections.heading: Export Controls on Drone-Related Items
paragraphs: Anadolu Ajansı reports that China will tighten export controls on drone-related dual-use items to the US for national security reasons.

sections.heading: Global Times Editorial
paragraphs: The Global Times editorial states that there is no need to show courtesy to the enforcers and accomplices of US sanctions against China.

faq.q: Why is China imposing sanctions on the US?
faq.a: China's sanctions are in response to American sanctions imposed on Chinese officials, as reported by CNN.
Dual-use items refer to goods and technologies that have both civilian and military applications, which is the context in which Anadolu Ajansı mentions them in relation to drone exports.
